newsitem.title: FRANCE: No Canadian Paris-LHR trucking service.
newsitem.headline: No Canadian Paris-LHR trucking service.

text.p: Canadian Airlines French cargo agent, Aero Cargo Interational, said there would not be a scheduled trucking service between Charles de Gaulle airport and London-Heathrow when the airline goes off-line from Paris, effective October 20.

"Trucking services on an ad hoc basis are a possibility in the event of high-volume shipment,but there are no plans for a regular road feeder link between CDG and Canadian's European Aero Cargo official told Reuters.
Canadian Airlines currently operates a daily Boeing 767-300ER passenger service between Paris and Toronto. -- Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
